correctness.rationale: Every palindrome of length at most ten uses at most five symbols. Equivalent palindromes share the same used alphabet; injective relabeling to five letters preserves all contiguous factor frequencies. Two standalone exhaustive Python verifiers independently check all 7810 five-letter palindromes at lengths 1..10: uniqueness before ten, precisely 50 doubletons and 3025 singleton profiles at ten, with the entire 50-pair set equal to the proposed two explicit symbolic families. The all-q counts follow by counting injections of distinct labels and no two families overlap.

evidence: The two-marker theorem assumes exactly two positions nonzero and n>=8, so it cannot cover the four nonmajority positions in the family with three pairwise distinct letters.
The 4-Abelian palindrome result asks whether one word is equivalent to its reversal; all ordinary palindromes satisfy that, irrespective of collisions between two distinct words.

value.rationale: The sharp reconstruction threshold under complete tri-gram multiplicity for ordinary palindromes is structurally motivated and alphabet-universal. The classification gives both independent mechanisms for first failure, a complete and parameterized equality layer, and exact numbers of usable distinguishing profiles; it is a natural short-block benchmark rather than an arbitrary slice.
